title: DRAFT-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Agents Across the Professional Design Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2611.08933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can frontier general-purpose agents understand client intent, explore creative directions, execute revisions, and prepare production deliverables? We introduce DRAFT-Bench (Design Reliability Across Feedback and Tasks), a lifecycle-oriented evaluation of requirement elicitation, creative exploration, constrained editing, iterative revision, and production handoff. Its Requirement-to-Artifact framework links evolving requirements, protected properties, artifact versions, and delivery obligations. We compare native Codex/Astra and Claude Code across 35 design briefs under 43 conditions, alongside a separate 40-scenario RFQ track. Astra completes 43/43 design conditions and Claude 35/43. All scored core runs receive full structural credit, yet on the 28 core conditions scored for both systems, semantic checks flag violations in 11 for Astra and 5 for Claude; these are model judgments, not expert-confirmed failure rates. RFQ coverage is high

translated_title: DRAFT-Bench：评估前沿智能体在专业设计全生命周期中的表现
translated_abstract: 前沿通用智能体能否理解客户意图、探索创意方向、执行修改并准备生产交付物？我们提出了DRAFT-Bench（跨反馈与任务的设计可靠性），这是一个面向生命周期的评估框架，涵盖需求获取、创意探索、受限编辑、迭代修改和生产交接五个环节。其“需求到制品”框架将不断演进的需求、受保护属性、制品版本和交付义务相互关联。我们在43种条件下、跨35个设计简报对原生Codex/Astra和Claude Code进行了比较，并另设了一个包含40个场景的询价单（RFQ）赛道。Astra完成了全部43个设计条件，Claude完成了35个。所有被评分的核心运行均获得完整的结构性学分，但在两个系统均被评分的28个核心条件中，语义检查标记出Astra有11处违规、Claude有5处违规；这些属于模型判断，而非专家确认的失败率。RFQ覆盖率较高。
tldr: 该论文提出了DRAFT-Bench，一个覆盖从需求获取到生产交付全流程的设计智能体评估基准，通过“需求到制品”框架对Codex/Astra和Claude Code进行结构与语义双重评估，发现智能体虽能完成任务但普遍存在语义违规。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DRAFT-Bench, a lifecycle-oriented benchmark evaluating frontier design agents from requirement elicitation to production handoff via a Requirement-to-Artifact framework, revealing that while agents structurally complete tasks, semantic violations remain common.
